Messages.Author: Snoop
Messages.Body:
Can you decide not to block after you announce to block and then the action
has been masked ? (with MoTF inf) or can you change the blocker ?

You can play a taste of vitae with a vampire with 0 blood on him (due to the
opponent strike) to gain 1 blood (for example) then play a Blur with that
blood to make 2 add Strikes.All in the same round. correct ?

You can redirect a bleed after the bleeder has play a bleed modifier. Or is
it an order to play modifiers/redirecters/reducers ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Snoop" <p_st...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Can you decide not to block after you announce to block and then the
action
> has been masked ? (with MoTF inf) or can you change the blocker ?

No and no (unless the new acting minion has more stealth than you
have intercept).

> You can play a taste of vitae with a vampire with 0 blood on him (due
to the
> opponent strike) to gain 1 blood (for example) then play a Blur with
that
> blood to make 2 add Strikes.All in the same round. correct ?

Correct.

> You can redirect a bleed after the bleeder has play a bleed modifier.

Correct.
